title: National Park Visits Fell 9 Million After A Record
hook: National park visits lost 9 million right after a record.
closing: Even a modest national decline can hit gateway jobs, staffing, and visitor access.
question: Which park would you visit?

segments.say: National park visits reached 331.9 million, setting the high point before the reversal.
National park visits then fell by nearly 9 million, immediately erasing the record's momentum.
Blue Ridge Parkway still drew 16.5 million visits, showing famous sites retained enormous pull.
